global: This is a bowl of tonkotsu ramen, its rich, creamy broth swirling around tender noodles and cabbage. A dollop of red chili paste sits atop, contrasting the pale broth in a white bowl with black Greek key patterns, set on a wooden table under warm light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows grain pattern, light brown color, smooth texture with subtle natural variations and slight sheen.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with black Greek key pattern and Japanese text along its rim.
regions.soup: The broth with noodles appears light brown, translucent, and slightly frothy, with thin noodles and vegetables floating within.
